verses.original: וַיְהִ֣י׀ הַשְּׁלִישִׁ֗י בַּיּ֣וֹם אֶסְתֵּר֙ וַתִּלְבַּ֤שׁ מַלְכ֔וּת וַֽתַּעֲמֹ֞ד הַפְּנִימִ֔ית בַּחֲצַ֤ר בֵּית־ הַמֶּ֙לֶךְ֙ נֹ֖כַח הַמֶּ֑לֶךְ בֵּ֣ית וְ֠הַמֶּלֶךְ יוֹשֵׁ֞ב עַל־ מַלְכוּתוֹ֙ כִּסֵּ֤א הַמַּלְכ֔וּת בְּבֵ֣ית נֹ֖כַח הַבָּֽיִת׃ פֶּ֥תַח
verses.transliteration: way·hî haš·šə·lî·šî bay·yō·wm ’es·têr wat·til·baš mal·ḵūṯ wat·ta·‘ă·mōḏ hap·pə·nî·mîṯ ba·ḥă·ṣar bêṯ- ham·me·leḵ nō·ḵaḥ ham·me·leḵ bêṯ wə·ham·me·leḵ yō·wō·šêḇ ‘al- mal·ḵū·ṯōw kis·sê ham·mal·ḵūṯ bə·ḇêṯ nō·ḵaḥ hab·bā·yiṯ pe·ṯaḥ
verses.literal: - On the third day Esther put on [her] royal [robes] and stood in the inner court of the palace . . . across from the king’s quarters The king was sitting on his royal throne in the royal courtroom facing the entrance

verses.original: וַיְהִי֩ הַמֶּ֜לֶךְ אֶת־ כִרְא֨וֹת הַמַּלְכָּ֗ה אֶסְתֵּ֣ר עֹמֶ֙דֶת֙ בֶּֽחָצֵ֔ר נָשְׂאָ֥ה חֵ֖ן בְּעֵינָ֑יו הַמֶּ֜לֶךְ וַיּ֨וֹשֶׁט הַזָּהָב֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר שַׁרְבִ֤יט בְּיָד֔וֹ לְאֶסְתֵּ֗ר אֶת־ אֶסְתֵּ֔ר וַתִּקְרַ֣ב וַתִּגַּ֖ע בְּרֹ֥אשׁ הַשַּׁרְבִֽיט׃ס
verses.transliteration: way·hî ham·me·leḵ ’eṯ- ḵir·’ō·wṯ ham·mal·kāh ’es·têr ‘ō·me·ḏeṯ be·ḥā·ṣêr nā·śə·’āh ḥên bə·‘ê·nāw ham·me·leḵ way·yō·wō·šeṭ haz·zā·hāḇ ’ă·šer šar·ḇîṭ bə·yā·ḏōw lə·’es·têr ’eṯ- ’es·têr wat·tiq·raḇ wat·tig·ga‘ bə·rōš haš·šar·ḇîṭ
verses.literal: - As soon as the king - saw Queen Esther standing in the court she found favor in his sight The king extended the gold - scepter in his hand toward Esther - and she approached and touched the tip of the scepter

verses.original: מַה־ לָּ֖ךְ הַמַּלְכָּ֑ה אֶסְתֵּ֣ר הַמֶּ֔לֶךְ וַיֹּ֤אמֶר לָהּ֙ וּמַה־ בַּקָּשָׁתֵ֛ךְ עַד־ חֲצִ֥י הַמַּלְכ֖וּת וְיִנָּ֥תֵֽן לָֽךְ׃
verses.transliteration: mah- lāḵ ham·mal·kāh ’es·têr ham·me·leḵ way·yō·mer lāh ū·mah- baq·qā·šā·ṯêḵ ‘aḏ- ḥă·ṣî ham·mal·ḵūṯ wə·yin·nā·ṯên lāḵ
verses.literal: What is it Queen Esther the king inquired What [is] your request Even up to half the kingdom it will be given to you

verses.original: אִם־ עַל־ הַמֶּ֖לֶךְ ט֑וֹב אֶסְתֵּ֔ר וַתֹּ֣אמֶר הַמֶּ֤לֶךְ וְהָמָן֙ יָב֨וֹא הַיּ֔וֹם אֶל־ הַמִּשְׁתֶּ֖ה אֲשֶׁר־ עָשִׂ֥יתִי לֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: ’im- ‘al- ham·me·leḵ ṭō·wḇ ’es·têr wat·tō·mer ham·me·leḵ wə·hā·mān yā·ḇō·w hay·yō·wm ’el- ham·miš·teh ’ă·šer- ‘ā·śî·ṯî lōw
verses.literal: If it pleases the king . . . Esther replied may the king and Haman come today to the banquet - I have prepared for [the king]

verses.original: מַהֲרוּ֙ וַיֹּ֣אמֶר הַמֶּ֔לֶךְ אֶת־ הָמָ֔ן לַעֲשׂ֖וֹת אֶת־ אֶסְתֵּ֑ר דְּבַ֣ר הַמֶּ֙לֶךְ֙ וְהָמָ֔ן וַיָּבֹ֤א אֶל־ הַמִּשְׁתֶּ֖ה אֲשֶׁר־ אֶסְתֵּֽר׃ עָשְׂתָ֥ה
verses.transliteration: ma·hă·rū way·yō·mer ham·me·leḵ ’eṯ- hā·mān la·‘ă·śō·wṯ ’eṯ- ’es·têr də·ḇar ham·me·leḵ wə·hā·mān way·yā·ḇō ’el- ham·miš·teh ’ă·šer- ’es·têr ‘ā·śə·ṯāh
verses.literal: Hurry commanded the king - and bring Haman so we can do - as Esther has requested So the king and Haman went to the banquet that Esther had prepared

verses.original: בְּמִשְׁתֵּ֣ה הַיַּ֔יִן הַמֶּ֤לֶךְ וַיֹּ֨אמֶר לְאֶסְתֵּר֙ מַה־ שְּׁאֵלָתֵ֖ךְ וְיִנָּ֣תֵֽן לָ֑ךְ וּמַה־ בַּקָּשָׁתֵ֛ךְ עַד־ חֲצִ֥י הַמַּלְכ֖וּת וְתֵעָֽשׂ׃
verses.transliteration: bə·miš·têh hay·ya·yin ham·me·leḵ way·yō·mer lə·’es·têr mah- šə·’ê·lā·ṯêḵ wə·yin·nā·ṯên lāḵ ū·mah- baq·qā·šā·ṯêḵ ‘aḏ- ḥă·ṣî ham·mal·ḵūṯ wə·ṯê·‘āś
verses.literal: And as they drank their wine the king said to Esther What is your petition It will be given to you What [is] your request Even up to half the kingdom it will be fulfilled
Esther . . . replied This is my petition and my request

verses.original: אִם־ מָצָ֨אתִי חֵ֜ן בְּעֵינֵ֣י הַמֶּ֗לֶךְ וְאִם־ עַל־ הַמֶּ֙לֶךְ֙ ט֔וֹב לָתֵת֙ אֶת־ שְׁאֵ֣לָתִ֔י וְלַעֲשׂ֖וֹת אֶת־ בַּקָּשָׁתִ֑י הַמֶּ֣לֶךְ וְהָמָ֗ן יָב֧וֹא וּמָחָ֥ר אֶל־ הַמִּשְׁתֶּה֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר אֶֽעֱשֶׂ֣ה לָהֶ֔ם אֶֽעֱשֶׂ֖ה הַמֶּֽלֶךְ׃ כִּדְבַ֥ר
verses.transliteration: ’im- mā·ṣā·ṯî ḥên bə·‘ê·nê ham·me·leḵ wə·’im- ‘al- ham·me·leḵ ṭō·wḇ lā·ṯêṯ ’eṯ- šə·’ê·lā·ṯî wə·la·‘ă·śō·wṯ ’eṯ- baq·qā·šā·ṯî ham·me·leḵ wə·hā·mān yā·ḇō·w ū·mā·ḥār ’el- ham·miš·teh ’ă·šer ’e·‘ĕ·śeh lā·hem ’e·‘ĕ·śeh ham·me·leḵ kiḏ·ḇar
verses.literal: If I have found favor in the sight of the king and if it pleases the king . . . to grant - my petition and fulfill - my request may the king and Haman come tomorrow to the banquet - I will prepare for them Then I will answer the king’s question

verses.original: הַה֔וּא בַּיּ֣וֹם הָמָן֙ וַיֵּצֵ֤א שָׂמֵ֖חַ וְט֣וֹב לֵ֑ב הַמֶּ֗לֶךְ בְּשַׁ֣עַר הָמָ֨ן אֶֽת־ וְכִרְאוֹת֩ מָרְדֳּכַ֜י וְלֹא־ קָם֙ וְלֹא־ זָ֣ע מִמֶּ֔נּוּ הָמָ֛ן וַיִּמָּלֵ֥א חֵמָֽה׃ עַֽל־ מָרְדֳּכַ֖י
verses.transliteration: ha·hū bay·yō·wm hā·mān way·yê·ṣê śā·mê·aḥ wə·ṭō·wḇ lêḇ ham·me·leḵ bə·ša·‘ar hā·mān ’eṯ- wə·ḵir·’ō·wṯ mā·rə·do·ḵay wə·lō- qām wə·lō- zā‘ mim·men·nū hā·mān way·yim·mā·lê ḥê·māh ‘al- mā·rə·do·ḵay
verses.literal: That day Haman went out full of joy and glad of heart At the king’s gate, however [he] - saw Mordecai who did not rise . . . or tremble in fear at his presence And Haman was filled with rage toward Mordecai

verses.original: הָמָ֔ן וַיִּתְאַפַּ֣ק וַיָּב֖וֹא אֶל־ בֵּית֑וֹ וַיִּשְׁלַ֛ח וַיָּבֵ֥א אֶת־ אֹהֲבָ֖יו וְאֶת־ אִשְׁתּֽוֹ׃ זֶ֥רֶשׁ
verses.transliteration: hā·mān way·yiṯ·’ap·paq way·yā·ḇō·w ’el- bê·ṯōw way·yiš·laḥ way·yā·ḇê ’eṯ- ’ō·hă·ḇāw wə·’eṯ- ’iš·tōw ze·reš
verses.literal: Nevertheless, Haman restrained himself and went . . . home And calling for . . . - his friends - and his wife Zeresh

verses.original: הָמָ֛ן אֶת־ וַיְסַפֵּ֨ר לָהֶ֥ם כְּב֥וֹד עָשְׁר֖וֹ וְרֹ֣ב בָּנָ֑יו וְאֵת֩ כָּל־ אֲשֶׁ֨ר הַמֶּ֙לֶךְ֙ וְאֵ֣ת אֲשֶׁ֣ר גִּדְּל֤וֹ נִשְּׂא֔וֹ עַל־ הַשָּׂרִ֖ים הַמֶּֽלֶךְ׃ וְעַבְדֵ֥י
verses.transliteration: hā·mān ’eṯ- way·sap·pêr lā·hem kə·ḇō·wḏ ‘ā·šə·rōw wə·rōḇ bā·nāw wə·’êṯ kāl- ’ă·šer ham·me·leḵ wə·’êṯ ’ă·šer gid·də·lōw niś·śə·’ōw ‘al- haś·śā·rîm ham·me·leḵ wə·‘aḇ·ḏê
verses.literal: Haman - recounted to them his glorious wealth his many sons and all the ways - the king - - had honored and promoted him over the other officials - and servants

verses.original: אַ֣ף הָמָן֒ וַיֹּאמֶר֮ הַמַּלְכָּ֧ה אֶסְתֵּ֨ר הֵבִיאָה֩ לֹא־ כִּ֣י אִם־ אוֹתִ֑י עִם־ הַמֶּ֛לֶךְ אֶל־ הַמִּשְׁתֶּ֥ה אֲשֶׁר־ עָשָׂ֖תָה אֲנִ֥י קָֽרוּא־ לָ֖הּ וְגַם־ לְמָחָ֛ר עִם־ הַמֶּֽלֶךְ׃
verses.transliteration: ’ap̄ hā·mān way·yō·mer ham·mal·kāh ’es·têr hê·ḇî·’āh lō- kî ’im- ’ō·w·ṯî ‘im- ham·me·leḵ ’el- ham·miš·teh ’ă·šer- ‘ā·śā·ṯāh ’ă·nî qā·rū- lāh wə·ḡam- lə·mā·ḥār ‘im- ham·me·leḵ
verses.literal: What is more Haman added Queen Esther invited no one but me to join the king at the banquet - she prepared and I am invited back tomorrow along with the king

verses.original: וְכָל־ אֵינֶ֥נּוּ זֶ֕ה שֹׁוֶ֖ה לִ֑י בְּכָל־ עֵ֗ת אֲשֶׁ֨ר אֲנִ֤י רֹאֶה֙ אֶת־ מָרְדֳּכַ֣י הַיְּהוּדִ֔י יוֹשֵׁ֖ב הַמֶּֽלֶךְ׃ בְּשַׁ֥עַר
verses.transliteration: wə·ḵāl ’ê·nen·nū zeh šō·weh lî bə·ḵāl ‘êṯ ’ă·šer ’ă·nî rō·’eh ’eṯ- mā·rə·do·ḵay hay·yə·hū·ḏî yō·wō·šêḇ ham·me·leḵ bə·ša·‘ar
verses.literal: Yet none . . . of this satisfies me as long as I see - Mordecai the Jew sitting at the king’s gate

verses.original: אִשְׁתּ֜וֹ זֶ֨רֶשׁ וְכָל־ אֹֽהֲבָ֗יו וַתֹּ֣אמֶר לוֹ֩ יַֽעֲשׂוּ־ עֵץ֮ חֲמִשִּׁ֣ים אַמָּה֒ גָּבֹ֣הַּ אֱמֹ֣ר לַמֶּ֗לֶךְ וּבַבֹּ֣קֶר׀ מָרְדֳּכַי֙ וְיִתְל֤וּ אֶֽת־ עָלָ֔יו וּבֹֽא־ אֶל הַמִּשְׁתֶּ֖ה עִם־ הַמֶּ֥לֶךְ שָׂמֵ֑חַ הַדָּבָ֛ר לִפְנֵ֥י וַיִּיטַ֧ב הָמָ֖ן הָעֵֽץ׃פ וַיַּ֥עַשׂ
verses.transliteration: ’iš·tōw ze·reš wə·ḵāl ’ō·hă·ḇāw wat·tō·mer lōw ya·‘ă·śū- ‘êṣ ḥă·miš·šîm ’am·māh gā·ḇō·ah ’ĕ·mōr lam·me·leḵ ū·ḇab·bō·qer mā·rə·do·ḵay wə·yiṯ·lū ’eṯ- ‘ā·lāw ū·ḇō- ʾɛl ham·miš·teh ‘im- ham·me·leḵ śā·mê·aḥ had·dā·ḇār lip̄·nê way·yî·ṭaḇ hā·mān hā·‘êṣ way·ya·‘aś
verses.literal: His wife Zeresh and all his friends told him Have them build a gallows fifty cubits high and ask the king in the morning to have Mordecai hanged - on it Then go to the banquet with the king and enjoy yourself The advice . . . pleased Haman and he had the gallows constructed
